3151.title: ACP steering cancels the active prompt
3151.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP bridge sends session/cancel for every active steer, then submits only the steer input as a new prompt.
3151.proposedFix: Choose ACP queue semantics and stop cancelling the active prompt, or retain hard-steer cancellation and surface the provider limitation; the tradeoff requires a product decision.
3151.caveats: Frequency on a real Cursor Grok account was not measured; both fake-agent runs reproduced the exact ACP wire behavior.
